illustrative.scope: Legacy illustrative sequence equivalent: preserves catalog impedances and zero charging. Uncalibrated research assumption, not manufacturer design parameters or Chinese engineering rules.

overhead.scope: Overhead ground-return sequence equivalent using legacy impedances; shunt charging neglected. Uncalibrated research assumption, not a geometry-derived conductor model, manufacturer design parameters or Chinese engineering rules.

cable.scope: Illustrative cable sequence equivalent with lower reactance, changed zero-sequence impedance and nonzero shunt charging. Sequence differences affect the equivalent phase self and mutual impedances; no explicit sheath, bonding or soil model. Uncalibrated research assumption, not manufacturer design parameters or Chinese engineering rules.
